citation: Sutherland, A., Broeks, M., Sim, M., Brown, E., Iakovidou, E., Ilie, S., Jarke, H., & Belanger, J. (2019). Digital Feedback in Primary Maths: Evaluation Report. London: Education Endowment Foundation (independently evaluated by RAND Europe; developed and delivered by KYRA Teaching School Alliance). September 2019.
report_number: EEF project: Digital Feedback in Primary Maths (efficacy trial; KYRA Teaching School Alliance developer; RAND Europe evaluator, September 2019)
design: Two-arm cluster-randomised controlled trial; unit of randomisation = Class (Year 4 and Year 5 classes WITHIN schools; within-school class-level design, no stratification at analysis); efficacy/developer-led trial; business-as-usual control (all schools received the digital-feedback training so control = no alternative treatment). 34 schools recruited (3 withdrew post-randomisation); 108 classes randomised (56 treatment / 52 control), 2,564 pupils. Primary-outcome ITT analysis sample = 2,133 pupils across 112 'classes' (58 intervention / 54 control) after allocation-linkage losses (431 pupils, ~17%, could not be linked to allocation). Subject: primary mathematics. Primary outcome: ACER Essential Learning Metric (ELM) for Mathematics (Years 4-5), paper-based, independently delivered/invigilated/marked by ACER, blinded invigilators. Secondary outcome: pupil disengagement (Engagement vs Disaffection survey, Skinner et al. 2008) - NOT an academic-achievement measure, so excluded per spec. Immediate post-test June 2018 (one school year of intervention, Sept 2017-June 2018).
problems: (1) SIGN TYPO IN SOURCE: The detailed effect-size table (Table 8, p.31) prints the primary ELM-maths Hedges g as '0.04 (95% CI -0.17, 0.09)', but (a) the executive-summary Table 1 (p.5) prints '-0.04 (-0.17, 0.09)', (b) the ITT treatment coefficient is b=-0.29 (favouring control; Table 14, p.89), (c) raw post-test means are intervention 18.4 < control 19.7 (Table 7, p.31), and (d) the CI (-0.17, 0.09) is centred at -0.04, not +0.04. ES = b/pooled-SD = -0.29/sqrt(41.99) = -0.29/6.480 = -0.0448 ~ -0.04. I therefore record g = -0.04 (the exec-summary value); the '0.04' in Table 8 is a sign transcription error in the report. (2) is_multi_arm=0 in the registry matches: this is a single TPD arm vs one business-as-usual control. (3) The disengagement/engagement secondary outcome is a behavioural/affective measure, not academic achievement, so it is NOT extracted (per spec: skip non-achievement outcomes). (4) The FSM-pupil result is a non-randomised subgroup (is_full_sample=false); its exec-summary g=0.04 (95% CI -0.24, 0.32, n=635) is extracted as a subgroup row. The detailed FSM model (Table 16) reports a cross-level FSM*treatment interaction (b=0.92, p=0.06) rather than a standalone FSM-only standardised effect, so the exec-summary subgroup g is the usable value. (5) Moderate-to-low EEF security (2/5 padlock) due to allocation-linkage problems and class-level (not school-level) randomisation raising contamination risk. (6) impact_se for each row is derived from the reported 95% CI (SE = CI width / (2*1.959964)); the report does not print the Hedges-g SE directly. (7) ICC (between-class) at analysis stage = 0.09 (Table 14); the cluster level here is the CLASS (teacher), consistent with the Teacher/Class assignment unit.

effect_sizes.arm_label: Digital Feedback in Primary Maths (KYRA) - single TPD arm (teacher training in effective feedback + Explain Everything app + diagnostic assessments) vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.test_name: ACER Essential Learning Metric (ELM) for Mathematics (Years 4-5)
effect_sizes.timepoint: post (June 2018, end of one school year of intervention)
effect_sizes.g_method: Hedges' g reported by the evaluator (exec-summary Table 1, p.5): ES = (Y_T - Y_C)_baseline-adjusted / pooled unconditional SD, per EEF/Hedges (2007) cluster-RCT guidance. Numerator = multilevel ANCOVA treatment coefficient b=-0.29 (Table 14, p.89), adjusting for KS1 baseline + year group, with class-level clustering and robust SEs. Denominator = pooled unconditional SD s* = sqrt[((n1-1)s1^2+(n2-1)s2^2)/(n1+n2-2)] = sqrt(41.99) = 6.480 (Table 8 pooled variance 41.99; group variances 42.03 int / 41.05 ctrl). Check: -0.29/6.480 = -0.0448 ~ -0.04. SE derived from reported 95% CI (-0.17, 0.09): SE = (0.09-(-0.17))/(2*1.959964) = 0.0663; g_var = SE^2 = 0.0044. mean_t/mean_c are RAW post-test ELM means (Table 7); sd_t/sd_c are sqrt of the group variances in Table 8 (these are the standardising variances, ~ raw post-test SDs).
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.5 Table 1 (exec summary) & p.31 Table 8 (effect size, sign typo) & p.31 Table 7 (raw means) & p.89 Table 14 (ITT model coefficient b=-0.29, se 0.43, ICC 0.09)
effect_sizes.notes: Headline confirmatory primary outcome. No evidence of impact: g=-0.04, p=0.507 (exec)/0.51 (ITT model); 0 estimated months' progress. Sign is NEGATIVE (favours control); see problems #1 re Table 8 typo. Cluster = class/teacher (analysis-stage between-class ICC 0.09; design-stage assumed 0.13). n_clusters=112 'classes' at analysis (58 int / 54 ctrl); n_t/n_c are pupils in the ITT model (1103 int / 1030 ctrl, total 2133). ELM Maths is an independently developed/administered/marked standardised maths assessment (ACER, aligned to National Curriculum) -> standardized_independent. Secondary disengagement outcome (Hedges g -0.09) NOT extracted (non-achievement).

effect_sizes.arm_label: Digital Feedback in Primary Maths (KYRA) - single TPD arm vs business-as-usual control [FSM-eligible pupils subgroup]
effect_sizes.test_name: ACER Essential Learning Metric (ELM) for Mathematics (Years 4-5) - FSM-eligible pupils
effect_sizes.timepoint: post (June 2018, end of one school year of intervention)
effect_sizes.g_method: Hedges' g for the FSM-eligible subgroup reported by the evaluator (exec-summary Table 1, p.5): same EEF/Hedges (2007) cluster-RCT adjusted-ES method as the full-sample primary outcome, applied to FSM-eligible pupils (FSM*treatment cross-level interaction modelled; Table 16, p.90). g=0.04 taken directly. SE derived from reported 95% CI (-0.24, 0.32): SE = (0.32-(-0.24))/(2*1.959964) = 0.1429; g_var = SE^2 = 0.0204. The report does not print a separate raw-means table or split n_t/n_c for this subgroup; total subgroup n=635 (exec Table 1) / n=2063 in the full FSM-interaction model. icc=0.08 = between-class ICC from the FSM-subgroup model (Table 16).
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.5 Table 1 (exec summary, 'Mathematics (FSM pupils)') & p.90 Table 16 (ELM maths FSM sub-group model)
effect_sizes.notes: Non-randomised FSM-eligible subgroup (is_full_sample=false; pre-specified but under-powered subgroup analysis per the report). g=+0.04 (95% CI -0.24, 0.32); exec p=0.061; 0 estimated months' progress; no significant FSM effect. n=635 in exec Table 1 (subgroup-specific) vs 2063 in the full cross-level interaction model; per-arm n not separately printed -> n_t/n_c null. Included so central merge can correctly down-weight/flag this as a subgroup.
